item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 27/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Doksuri will move in the general direction of the coastal areas of southern Fujian and eastern Guangdong, moving inland and weakening gradually in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, under the influence of Doksuri and the subsequent active southwesterly airstream, it will be windier with squally showers over the coast of southeastern China. With the southerly airstream weakening, the weather will be brighter over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the western North Pacific will move in the general direction of the seas south of the Ryukyu Islands in the next few days.

Date/Month: 28/07 (Friday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and squally thunderstorms. There will be swells. Showers will increase gradually later.
Temp range: 26 - 32 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
